title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Enrolled in Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or related STEM field
qualification: Pursuing degree in CS/CE with programming experience in C++, C#, Java, or Python.
description: Work alongside full-time engineers on real-world software products, building scalable solutions and innovative features across Microsoft Cloud and AI services.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
qualification: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vue.js or React, and familiarity with Git workflow.
description: Help build and refine user interfaces for GitLab's DevOps platform, collaborate with cross-functional global teams, and contribute to open-source software.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
organization: University of Cambridge & Gates Cambridge Trust
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the UK pursuing a postgraduate degree at Cambridge
qualification: Outstanding academic record, leadership potential, and commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Full-cost scholarships for postgraduate study in any subject available at the University of Cambridge for international applicants.

title: Associate Data Analyst
eligibility: Recent graduates or professionals with 0-2 years of analytical experience
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical experience; SQL and Python/R.
description: Analyze complex datasets to extract actionable insights, build executive dashboards, and optimize business operations across Google Cloud products.

title: Imagine Cup 2025 Global Student Competition
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university worldwide
qualification: Teams of up to 4 students leveraging Microsoft Azure to build innovative software solutions.
description: Global student technology competition focused on using AI and cloud tech to solve critical social, economic, and environmental challenges.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science

qualification: No prior programming or computer science experience required.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
